features.name: Independent sporting target and rules reference
features.definition: Versioned price-free target specification fixed before modeling and freeze: entity, outcome/statistic, counting population, phase/game type, rules version, regulation/OT/SO and exceptional-goal accounting, participation conditions, and supported distribution/projection scope. Provider selection, quote, payout and settlement mapping remain in market_contract after freeze.
features.population: Independent sporting target; no market prices or provider forecasts
features.availability: Define and pin before independent computation and independent_snapshot_frozen_at, using the rules/evidence versions legitimately available at cutoff T.
features.missing: Missing or ambiguous target/counting/rules definition makes the dependent forecast UNSUPPORTED; never infer the target from prices.
features.validation: All independent outputs link to this immutable version. Any later provider mapping must match the frozen statistic, phase, outcome support and rules; unsupported mappings fail closed.
features.use: Defines model labels, output meaning and projection support; not an ordinary model covariate

protocol.definition: Proposed Feature Dictionary v0.2, 2026-10-10. Supersedes the v0.1 planning definitions while preserving all 142 prior base field IDs and adding independent_target_ref (143 total). Not a trained model, selected/certified feature set, or repository-local Daily-NHL architecture. Numeric examples are synthetic.

Definitions of evidence, feature families, internal estimates and downstream outputs for pregame NHL. Live has separate snapshot identity, cutoffs and evaluation. Repository documentation only; no source adapter, feature computation, model, production integration or Bridge execution authority is implemented or certified.

(snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, opponent_id where relevant, field_id, measure_variant_id, population_id, window_id, transform_version). Variant ID distinguishes event type/tracking metric/component. Base measures expand only into explicitly configured variants, not every possible training column.

value plus numerator/count, exposure/denominator, eligible_count, observed_count and coverage where applicable; otherwise null/NOT_APPLICABLE. Always retain quality_status, missing_reason, available_at, source_snapshot_id and definition_version. Model estimates additionally require internal_model_id/training_cutoff. Every forecast also pins independent_target_ref before freeze; provider market mapping is not its target-definition authority.

EVIDENCE = factual observation/state. DESCRIPTIVE = deterministic aggregate. MODEL_FEATURE = candidate independent covariate. INTERNAL_ESTIMATE = output of an upstream TDL model. TRAINING_LABEL = future outcome for a fitted component. FORECAST_OUTPUT = sealed prediction. MARKET_ONLY = downstream market evidence/calculation. CONTROL = provenance/eligibility; not an ordinary numeric covariate.

FOUNDATION is required for the dependent capability. CORE_CANDIDATE is in the first research set, not a proven selected feature. SUPPORTING is retained for diagnostics or incremental tests. LATER is deferred until evidence and validation support it. OUTPUT_ONLY and POST_FREEZE do not belong in the independent design matrix.
SOURCE_MAPPING_REQUIRED; DERIVATION_NOT_BUILT; MODEL_NOT_BUILT; OPTIONAL_FEED_UNVERIFIED; POST_FREEZE_ONLY. This dictionary makes no claim that source adapters or models already exist.

Store elapsed time and ice time in seconds, coordinates/distances with explicit feet or km, timestamps in UTC with venue IANA time zone retained. Store proportions as fractions 0..1. Display percentages separately; shooting-minus-expected uses fraction internally and percentage points in a report.
per60 = 3600 * SUM(event count or expected-goal value) / SUM(eligible ice_time_seconds). Denominator must match entity, state, window and eligibility. Do not average game-level per60 rates.
share = SUM(for) / (SUM(for) + SUM(against)) for matching populations. Numerator 0 with a positive denominator is a legitimate 0. A zero or missing denominator yields null with reason.

GSAx is xGA - GA, so positive indicates goals prevented above that declared baseline. Rest and time-zone differences have explicitly declared direction. No field's sign is inferred from its name alone.

At forecast cutoff T, an evidence version is eligible only if its defensible available_at <= T and the relevant historical play occurred before T. Pregame aggregates use only completed, eligible prior games by default. Never filter by date alone.

Retain effective_at, source_published_at if provided, first_observed_at, ingested_at and available_at. Prospective default: available_at is the later of first observation and a trustworthy publication timestamp. A dated webpage fetched later does not prove earlier availability.
Earlier available_at requires certified immutable as-of evidence. If not reconstructable, mark PIT_AMBIGUOUS and exclude from that historical experiment; do not backdate to game date.

Append each corrected event, goalie report, lineup or schedule version. A replay selects the latest eligible version at its cutoff. A new forecast links supersedes_snapshot_id without changing the prior snapshot.

Internal xG, talent, opportunity, opponent adjustment, normalization, shrinkage and imputation must be fitted only within the training history of that fold/cutoff. Store model version and training cutoff. OOF/forward predictions are required for learned stackers.

Independent sporting target/counting/rules definitions and supported output scope are fixed through independent_target_ref before computation and freeze. After independent_snapshot_frozen_at, market_contract maps a provider selection to that frozen distribution under a supported deterministic projection. Prices never refit the model or change its frozen distribution. Quote changes may re-evaluate value; new sport evidence requires a new independent snapshot.

Retain period_type REG/OT/SO, own/opponent skater counts, both goalie-presence flags, penalty advantage, delayed penalty status and pre-event score separately. These fields are the state authority; convenience buckets never discard them.
Regulation, five skaters per team, both goalies present. Intervals are [start,end), exclude stoppages, and use pre-event state for events. Do not combine 4v4 or overtime 5v5 with REG5V5.
Regulation 5v4 or 4v5, both goalies present, with verified penalty manpower context. Numerators and seconds use that exact state. Other PP/PK states such as 5v3 and 4v3 remain separate variants.

REG_OTHER_OCCUPIED retains exact skater counts and penalty context. OWN_EMPTY, OPP_EMPTY and BOTH_EMPTY retain simultaneous penalty state, e.g. 6v4. Goalies absent due to tactical pull versus delayed penalty are distinct when known; unknown reason stays unknown.

Overtime is separately tagged with game type/rules version and exact manpower. Shootout events are excluded from ordinary shot/xG/goalie feature populations and modeled/settled under separate contracts.

Penalty shots, awarded goals, shootout attempts and shootout score adjustments have separate flags and records. Ordinary chance-model populations exclude them by default. Reconcile official result/individual-stat targets using their own contracts, not by forcing all totals to match.

Ordinary SOG = saved physical shots + physical goals. Fenwick/unblocked attempts = SOG + missed attempts. Corsi/all attempts = Fenwick + blocked attempts. A blocked attempt belongs to the shooting team, not the blocker. Preserve original event codes.

Team minutes are wall-clock playing intervals; skater/goalie minutes require actual participation. Sum overlapping shift intervals once per participant. Confirmed no appearance is zero exposure, not missing shifts. Unknown participation invalidates dependent on-ice rates.

Define OZ_faceoff_start_share = OZ/(OZ+DZ), neutral excluded, and retain NZ and on-the-fly counts separately. This is a chosen TDL convention; never silently substitute a provider denominator including neutral/on-the-fly starts.

Current season and explicit game type through T. Only prior completed games whose selected evidence versions were available at T. Playoffs and regular season remain separate unless a versioned training rule explicitly combines them.

Prior 5/10/20 eligible completed games for a team; prior eligible appearances for a skater/goalie. Retain actual game count, starts/relief count and exposure. Team schedule workload windows include non-appearance separately. These are candidate windows, not certified weights.
Previous two complete seasons of the explicit game type, cut off at T. Candidate prior-support window; roster/team history and player transfers are retained. No automatic 70/30 season blend.

Trailing 7/14*24 hours ending at T for historical workload totals. Exact timestamps define boundaries. A future schedule-density field must be named separately and can use only schedule versions known at T.

Optional exponential decay: w_j = exp(-ln(2)*age_days_j/h). weighted_per60 = 3600*SUM(w_j*c_j)/SUM(w_j*seconds_j). Half-life h is tuned on chronological training folds, not guessed or optimized on final holdout.

Proposed rate smoothing: lambda=(C+lambda_prior*E0)/(E+E0), with consistent exposure units. Proportion smoothing: p=(successes+alpha)/(trials+alpha+beta). Priors/grouping are training-only and undecided. Weighted/decayed versions are smoothing forms, not automatically exact posterior distributions.

Unknown value -> null plus a reason. No applicable state or no exposure -> null for rates, even if event counts are 0. Known zero events over positive complete exposure -> numeric 0. Do not default missing xG, goalie IDs or travel to 0.

Store usable eligible event count/eligible count and observed seconds/required seconds. Unknown denominator -> unknown coverage. Incomplete xG -> full-population model value null absent a validated estimator; partial sums are diagnostics on a separately identified scored subset, never paired with a full denominator.

Missing/conflicting mandatory evidence blocks the model or market that requires it. Another model may run only if its own predeclared inputs, fallback and calibration are satisfied. Do not call unsupported predictions PASS; preserve UNSUPPORTED separately from a recommendation gate.
Unknown tracking or optional event context stays null with indicators. An optional-feature model needs validated missing-data treatment; absence does not justify invented observations.
Use VALID, PARTIAL, MISSING, ZERO_EXPOSURE, NOT_APPLICABLE, CONFLICT, PIT_AMBIGUOUS, or UNSUPPORTED. These are data statuses, distinct from BET/LEAN/WATCH/PASS/AVOID.

Proposed two-stage UA baseline: q_i=P(SOG|UA, pre-outcome X), fitted on UA; r_i=P(goal|SOG, pre-outcome X), fitted on SOG but evaluated on all UA including misses. xg_ua_i=q_i*r_i. Both stages require predictors defined before outcome on all UA; SOG-only placement/trajectory needs integration or a separate model. Neutral shooter/goalie reference.

For SOG, xga_sog=SUM(r_i); GA and SOG use exactly the same eligible goalie-assigned population. GSAx_SOG=xga_sog-GA; xsv=1-xga_sog/SOG; sv=(SOG-GA)/SOG. Incomplete scoring cannot pair partial xGA with full GA/SOG. Scored-subset diagnostics retain separate subset identity and coverage.

Estimate shrinkage-adjusted shooter/goalie effects separately from the neutral shot-quality baseline, or in one identified model. Do not apply the same skill effect both inside baseline xG and again in the game simulator.

These features remain reserved in v0.2; production thresholds and labeling rules are undecided. They remain LATER/inactive until a versioned region, threshold or sequence classifier with coverage and validation is selected.

Realized-shot xG sums and sequence scoring probability are different quantities. A simulation that scores a goal terminates that possession/sequence. Do not add repeated rebound opportunities that would not exist after that goal.

CONFIRMED requires attributable explicit evidence as of T; PROBABLE is a reported/estimated state with source. UNKNOWN and CONFLICT remain explicit. Store goalie-specific scenario outputs if required, and do not infer the starter from odds.

Weights need a documented internal estimate or other allowed factual basis. If weights are unavailable, publish conditional scenarios/range; do not silently assign 50/50. Confirmed-start-dependent goalie props remain unsupported until their own conditions are met.
On each matching population: SOG=GOAL+SAVE; FF=SOG+MISS; CF=FF+BLOCK. Goalie saves=eligible SOG faced-eligible goals allowed. Record exceptions outside these populations separately.

Mutually exclusive team interval durations sum to known playing time for the selected phase. Do not count stoppages or double-count overlaps. Sum of skater exposure matches skater-count-integral when shifts are complete.
0<=q_i,r_i,xg_ua_i<=1. 0<=SUM(xg_ua)<=eligible UA count; 0<=xga_sog<=eligible SOG count. For matching goalie sample, sv-xsv=GSAx_SOG/SOG.

Regulation home win + tie + away win =1. Completed-game home+away win=1 only for contracts guaranteed decisive. Player/team/goalie simulations reconcile under their declared target rules. Probability uncertainty is distinct from the distribution of possible scores.

B1/B2 are original project authority pinned to the verified source commit; linked current companion documents retain their own authority. D1-D4 are reviewed terminology/public-description references. E/S/A/V/T/M are acquisition classes, not verified adapters; I denotes proposed TDL artifacts. reviewed_at records the planning/reference review, not data access, historical coverage, rights, freshness or operational validation. Acquisition/model records retain verified_at=null and explicit unverified/unbuilt status.

The independent sporting target/counting/rules definition is pinned before freeze; provider settlement/threshold/push/void/fee mapping is attached afterward only within supported frozen output scope. For a stake-returned push contract and p_win>0: fair decimal d=(1-p_push)/p_win and EV=p_win*(d-1)-p_loss before explicit expected fees. With p_win=0 no finite fair win price is defined; all-push cases have no action. Do not use this contract for every binary exchange without mapping.

Dictionary availability does not imply model selection. Compare justified feature groups in walk-forward folds; use held-out calibration, preserve all supported forecasts and BET/LEAN/WATCH/PASS/AVOID states, and assess results by goalie certainty, rest/back-to-back/workload, manpower/state, market class, regulation/OT/SO target/rules and season phase. Dated factual coaching context may be retained; any estimated coaching effect needs independent chronological evidence.

decisions.detail: Separate regulation, overtime, shootout, penalty shots and awarded/scoring exceptions.
Use ordinary unblocked attempts for neutral team xG; retain all attempts for volume/blocking.
Use explicitly named conditional-on-SOG xGA, expected SV and GSAx for goalie comparison.
Orthogonal state fields, mutually exclusive intervals, both goalies present for REG5V5; matching seconds.
Use official opportunity counts as their own evidence. PP-state time remains a separate measure.
Conservative first-observed/source publication availability; no backdated historical certainty without certified archive evidence.
Missing/zero-exposure stays null with reason; branch-local support and only validated predeclared fallbacks.
Sourced status and named conditional forecasts; mixture only with justified internal weights.
S2D, G5/G10/G20, H2S and D7/D14 are explicitly defined candidates. No chosen blend, half-life or minimum samples.
Choose/version geometric region or neutral-xG threshold only after source support and training-only research.
Define observed vs proxy sequence labels, thresholds, termination and coverage before activation.
Train internal adjustment and reference population chronologically; no third-party rating offsets.
Event, shift, availability, schedule and optional tracking schemas/history/rights/freshness require acquisition verification.
Measure group contribution in chronological folds. Dictionary inclusion does not mean all columns enter each model.

Specify independent sporting target/counting/rules contracts before freeze and validate downstream provider settlement mappings. Goalie-start support, calibration, PIT replay and manual end-to-end proof precede production.
